title: Banks Prepare $7.15 Billion Debt Deal for Sealed Air Buyout
title_zh: 银行为 Sealed Air 收购准备 71.5 亿美元债务交易
summary: Lenders including JPMorgan are gauging investor demand for loans and bonds backing Clayton Dubilier & Rice's Sealed Air acquisition.
summary_zh: 包括摩根大通在内的贷款机构正在评估投资者对支持 Clayton Dubilier & Rice 收购 Sealed Air 的贷款和债券的需求。

title: Salesforce surges 3% on $25 billion debt offering to fund massive share buyback
title_zh: Salesforce 股价飙升 3%，发行 250 亿美元债券为大规模股票回购提供资金
summary: The cloud software giant said it will deploy all net proceeds from the debt issuance into ASR transactions with certain financial institution counterparties, with prepayment and initial share delivery expected to occur on March 16, 2026.
summary_zh: 这家云软件巨头表示，将把债券发行的所有净收益用于与某些金融机构交易对手的 ASR 交易，预付款和首次股份交付预计将于 2026 年 3 月 16 日进行。

title: Papa John’s Draws Fresh Takeover Interest From Qatari-Backed Fund
title_zh: 棒约翰吸引了卡塔尔支持的基金的新收购兴趣
summary: A Qatari-backed investment fund has submitted a bid to take pizza chain  Papa John’s International  private, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，一家卡塔尔支持的投资基金已提交收购披萨连锁店棒约翰国际 (Papa John’s International) 私有化的报价。

title: Papa John’s Stock Jumps on Reported Takeover Bid
title_zh: 棒约翰股价因收购要约而上涨
summary: Shares of  Papa John’s International  jumped sharply Wednesday after a report that the pizza chain has attracted fresh takeover interest.
summary_zh: 棒约翰国际公司的股价周三大幅上涨，此前有报道称这家披萨连锁店吸引了新的收购兴趣。
